Details
{{dettagli}}

The fee includes
  • Online placement test before the course starts
  • Certificate of attendance
  • {{ore}} lessons a week Italian lessons · lessons outside the classroom (conversation, visits) · Italian design and craft workshops · pronunciation lessons
  • Certificate of evaluation based on the European framework, with credits
  • Course materials and access to the Moodle platform
  • Preparation for the CILS and Roma Tre certification exams
  • Activities, workshops and facilities: see Student life

Student life

The course fee also includes activities, facilities and visits

Every week

  • A lesson outside the classroom: conversation and guided visits in Assisi
  • A pronunciation lesson

Every two weeks

  • A workshop of your choice: manuscripts and illumination, bookbinding, Italian design and craft, cooking

At the Academy

  • Music room with piano, video library, library
  • Academy card: discounts in restaurants and shops, free entry to 4 museums in Assisi
  • Free wi-fi
  • Help with visas and accommodation
